free_tier.stated: The Actor is free to use and the user pays only for Apify platform usage; the Free plan is $0 a month with $5 of included usage a month, $0.2 per compute unit, 16 GB maximum RAM and 5 concurrent runs.
free_tier.notes: The $5 allowance is dollars of platform usage, not a fixed run count. 1 CU = 1 GB of RAM running for 1 hour.

per_object_cap.stated: Files written through the sandbox filesystem API are capped at 500 MB per file; the Actor's build/run disk is 2 times the job memory limit.

retention.stated: Filesystem changes are backed up to the Actor's key-value store and restored after a container migration; the sandbox shuts down after 900 seconds of inactivity by default, and unused prepaid usage expires at the end of the billing cycle.
retention.notes: Idle timeout is 900 seconds by default and can be set to 0 to disable it; each Actor request has a 5-minute ceiling.

egress.terms: Pay-per-usage Actor: the user pays for platform usage including compute units, data transfer, storage operations and residential or SERP proxies, drawn on the plan's prepaid usage. Free-plan access is blocked until the next monthly cycle when the $5 is spent. A per-GB data-transfer price is not stated on the pricing page read.

interface_detail: Connect to the running sandbox over a Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint, a REST API (/exec, /fs, /bridges, /health) and an interactive ttyd browser shell; the Actor itself is launched from the Apify Console, API, CLI or MCP server.
tooling: apify-cli, apify-client for JavaScript and Python, the hosted Apify MCP server at mcp.apify.com, or a direct REST call; no local server is installed by the user, the Actor runs on Apify's platform.
chaining: A managed container for running agent-generated code with MCP and REST access, bridges to expose a local dev server at a public URL, and state backed up across migrations; bind it to an object-storage record for results that must outlive the sandbox's idle shutdown.

limits.value: $5 of included platform usage a month on Free; overage blocks access until the next monthly cycle
$0.2 per compute unit on Free, where 1 CU = 1 GB of RAM running for 1 hour; 5 concurrent runs and 16 GB maximum RAM
500 MB per file written through /fs; 5-minute ceiling on every Actor request
Idle timeout shuts the container down after 900 seconds of inactivity by default

limits_note: Maximum combined memory of all running jobs on Free is 16,384 MB; build timeout is 1800 seconds and build memory is 4,096 MB. Prepaid usage does not roll over.
binding_note: The $5 monthly platform-usage allowance is what runs out first: at $0.2 per compute unit it funds 25 compute-unit hours of 1 GB RAM before all free access stops for the cycle.

identity_cost.detail: Running the Actor requires an Apify account; the Free plan needs no credit card. An autonomous agent with a crypto wallet can instead pay once at agi.apify.com through x402 or MPP and get a temporary token with a fixed spend cap, with no account and no human sign-up.

reliability_note: Free-plan access is blocked until the next billing cycle when prepaid usage runs out, and the container shuts down after the idle timeout; each request has a 5-minute ceiling. Prepaid usage does not carry over.
confidence_note: The rates, idle timeout and interface are quoted from Apify's own Actor page and pricing page read on 2026-11-24.
